description: Election bodies: what the site needs to know about a body it files elections under (its elections are in data/elections-source/data/elections/<id>/), kept as data so a new body is added here rather than in each builder and view. A body listed here is read from here first; the bodies not yet listed are still described by the lists in the code that predate this registry (scripts/build/build-test2-election-manifest.mjs resolveElectionGeography and votingSystemForElection, scripts/lib/election-names.mjs, packages/map/src/app/helpers.mjs, src/catalogue/view-elections.js and search.js, scripts/build/build-browse-indexes.mjs, scripts/build/build-party-profiles.mjs, scripts/build/catalogue/build-catalogue.mjs). Fields: name (the body as elections_index.json names it); jurisdiction; typeLabel (the kind of election, as the map app labels a candidacy); shortLabel and shelf (the catalogue's Elections rows and shelves, src/catalogue/view-elections.js BODY_GROUPS ids); searchTerms (catalogue search); title and wikipediaTitle ({year} is the election's year); wholeArea (every election of the body covers its whole area, so none is a by-election); votingSystem; partyGroup (the party profiles' chart, scripts/build/build-party-profiles.mjs); geography (the map its elections are drawn on, by date, with the feature a result names where the names differ); areaResults (a national contest's figures broken down by the areas it was counted in, filed in `dir`/<date>/: shown as a second geography of the one election, never as candidacies). Schema: packages/registries/schemas/election-bodies.schema.json; views: packages/registries/src/election-bodies.mjs.

areaResults.note: The Presidential Returning Officer's figures for each area the votes were counted in: Dáil constituencies, and in 1945 counties and county boroughs. They break down the one national result; no candidacy is counted per area.

sources: Presidential Returning Officer, Toghcháin Uachtaráin / Presidential Elections 1938–2025 (January 2026), https://www.presidentialelection.ie/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Presidential-Elections-1938-2025.pdf
